translations.web: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was “The Twin Brothers.”
translations.bsb: After three months we set sail in an Alexandrian ship that had wintered in the island. It had the Twin Brothers as a figurehead.
translations.kjv: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
translations.asv: And after three months we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was The Twin Brothers.
